MGCB and MGFX support with DesktopVK Profile
Yotsuba Framework supports MonoGame effects compiled with the DesktopVK profile on Apple platforms through the Metal backend.
This gives existing projects a familiar content path: author effects in the MGFX and .fx workflow, build them through MGCB, and let Yotsuba provide the runtime translation to the target graphics API.
Preserve your content pipeline while changing the rendering destination.

The framework is designed to keep game code and content libraries useful across targets. Your project can continue to think in MonoGame terms while the backend focuses on delivering a native Metal path for Apple hardware.
